name: Vexor Custom Woodworking Tools
old_description: Vexor creates custom router bits and custom insert tooling for woodworking applications.
about:
Vexor Custom Woodworking Tools operates from Denver, Colorado, where it designs and manufactures custom router bits and insert tooling for woodworking applications. The company also provides sharpening, reconditioning, and balancing services for a wide range of cutting tools.

Its product line includes custom router bits, shaper cutters, and the Multi-Pro family of insert tooling, which allows users to swap profiles without purchasing dedicated tools. Vexor runs a machine shop equipped with a diverse range of CNC machines, including five-axis milling centers, enabling it to produce tooling and offer contract machining services. Every tool is balanced to the industry standard grade for its rated RPM.

The company serves woodworking businesses that require precision cutting tools and maintenance services. Customers include cabinet shops, furniture makers, and other wood-processing operations that rely on router bits, shaper cutters, and insert tooling for production.

Vexor emphasizes personal service and competitive pricing, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for custom tooling and sharpening. The Multi-Pro system was developed to give customers flexibility and reduce the cost of profile changes compared to traditional dedicated insert tooling.

name: Via Seating
old_description: Design-forward, ergonomic and sustainable lounge crafted for modern commercial interiors.
about:
Via Seating was established in 1987 in Sparks, Nevada, near the High Sierras and Lake Tahoe. The company operates as part of the Flokk family, a European leader in high-quality seating solutions.

The company designs and manufactures ergonomic seating for commercial interiors, including task chairs (Onda, Rise, Run II), lounge collections (Coleurí), and specialized solutions such as the patented antimicrobial Copper Mesh line and True Sit-to-Stand models with telescoping gas lifts (4-UP, Onda). Proprietary injection-molded comfort foam, engineered with certified ergonomists, provides multi-density support rated for over 12 years. Digital specification tools—Spec It for real-time 4K rendering and quoting, plus pricing and material libraries—support the design workflow.

Via Seating serves corporate, healthcare, education, public sector, biotech, and outdoor markets, with dedicated look books for higher education. Its products are specified by architects and designers for environments ranging from offices to hospitals and learning spaces.

Sustainability is embedded through a Design for Environment process, life cycle assessments, and environmental product declarations. The company emphasizes lean manufacturing and design-driven innovation, aiming to enhance well-being through comfort, functionality, and aesthetics.

name: Vicor Rhode Island (Previously Picor Corporation)
old_description: Get the free eBook: Accelerate your move to a high performance 48V power delivery network.
about:
Vicor Rhode Island, located in Lincoln, Rhode Island, operates as part of Vicor Corporation under the name previously known as Picor Corporation. The facility focuses on high-density power conversion modules for 48V power delivery networks.

The company designs and manufactures modular power solutions optimized for 48V power delivery, including BCM® bus converters and ChiP-based modules. Its capabilities include parallel operation to attain higher power levels beyond a single module's capacity, and a Power System Designer tool that generates recommended power delivery networks sorted by efficiency, component count, and cost. Press releases note acquisition of sites for additional ChiP fabrication facilities.

Vicor serves the automotive sector—its BCM bus converter won a 2026 Electronics Excellence Award for automotive innovation—and industrial applications with modular power delivery networks. Customers use the technology in AI infrastructure, data centers, and other high-performance systems.

Vicor emphasizes a quality policy committed to superior products and services delivered on time, backed by ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certifications. The company maintains a conflict minerals policy aligned with Dodd-Frank requirements, energy conservation programs saving over six million kilowatt-hours annually, and active waste management and recycling diverting hundreds of thousands of pounds from waste streams.

name: Viking Electronics
old_description: You have questions. We have user forums, product docs, and American technicians ready for your call.
about:
Viking Electronics has been designing and building security and communication products for over 55 years from its headquarters in Hudson, Wisconsin. The privately held company operates all engineering, production, and shipping functions at that single Midwestern location.

The product line exceeds 500 items, spanning emergency phones, entry systems, paging interfaces, amplifiers, mass notification systems, hotline phones, auto dialers, enclosures, and a growing portfolio of SIP‑compliant VoIP endpoints. Every unit is designed, manufactured, and tested in‑house, with the company’s Enhanced Weather Protection (EWP) process encapsulating entire circuit boards in a clear polymer to withstand extreme outdoor conditions.

Primary markets include K‑12 schools, university campuses, commercial facilities, and public‑address installations where reliable voice communication and access control are critical. Customers range from district‑level IT directors to security integrators specifying Viking’s IP‑based intercoms, panic buttons, and multicast paging adapters.

Viking differentiates itself by keeping all support staff in Hudson — no outsourced call centers — so technicians can draw on decades of field experience when answering product questions. A two‑year limited warranty covers the entire catalog, and new product development is driven directly by installer and end‑user feedback collected through forums and direct technical calls.

name: VilleSide Customs
old_description: Banners, Digital Printing, Screen Printing, Embroidery, Stickers, and More
about:
VilleSide Customs, LLC operates as a custom print shop at 491 Broadway in Somerville, Massachusetts. The company opened in November 2013, founded by Jabir, who brought screen-printing experience from the heat-transfer industry, and Marckendy, who managed the Boston streetwear brand P.A.P. Clothing. The two partners established the business to provide custom merchandise services to the local community.

The shop offers a range of decoration methods including screen printing, embroidery, vinyl heat-transfer printing, digital printing, banner production, and sticker manufacturing. They accept customer-supplied goods or provide blank apparel themselves, handling orders of any size with a standard two-week turnaround and rush options. The facility also produces its own line of branded hoodies and T-shirts sold directly through its website.

Clients span real estate firms such as J.R. Pierre Real Estate and Bruno Realty, non-profits like the Gosner Cherilus Foundation, food-service businesses including The Neighborhood Restaurant, Pikliz, and The Falafel Place, youth sports organizations such as Somerville Pop Warner and Cambridge Pop Warner, plus painting and construction contractors. The company also serves schools, teams, and other local organizations.

VilleSide emphasizes low minimum orders, a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and in-house design assistance that works with customer-supplied PDF or Illustrator files or helps create artwork from scratch. The partners cite their combined industry experience and commitment to customer feedback as the foundation of their service.

name: Virginia Diodes Inc
old_description: Virginia Diodes Inc. offers products for millimeter-wave and THz transmit and receive systems. VDI offers many customized solutions optimized for specific customer applications.
about:
Virginia Diodes Inc. (VDI) is headquartered in Charlottesville, Virginia. The company was founded in 1996 by Dr. Thomas W. Crowe, who serves as CEO. It began as a spin‑off from the University of Virginia, initially selling only Schottky diodes for scientific applications such as radio astronomy and high‑frequency radar.

Today VDI manufactures state‑of‑the‑art test and measurement equipment for millimeter‑wave and terahertz frequencies. Its product line includes vector network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, and signal generator extension modules that push microwave measurement tools beyond 50 GHz. The company also produces component‑level devices — detectors, mixers, frequency multipliers, and custom systems — all built around in‑house fabricated GaAs Schottky diodes and microelectronic filter structures. Operations are housed in a 20,000‑square‑foot high‑tech facility staffed by roughly 100 engineers, technicians, and administrative personnel.

VDI serves scientific, military, and commercial markets. Early customers included radio astronomy observatories and radar programs; the portfolio has since expanded to support terahertz transmitter and receiver modules for a range of defense and research applications.

The firm’s stated mission is to make the terahertz region of the electromagnetic spectrum as useful as the microwave and infrared bands. This focus on extending measurement capability into the THz band, combined with vertical integration of diode fabrication, is presented as its core differentiator.

name: Vishay Dale Electronics, LLC
old_description: Save space while delivering improved signal transmission quality and enhanced robustness against electrical spikes and RF and EMI issues
about:
Vishay Dale Electronics, LLC operates from Yankton, South Dakota, as a division of Vishay Intertechnology, Inc., a global manufacturer of discrete semiconductors and passive electronic components. The facility serves as one of the company's key production sites for a broad portfolio of electronic parts.

The company produces a wide range of components including optical sensors, power modules in SOT-227 packages, diodes in compact DFN packages, standard rectifiers, bidirectional transient voltage suppressors, position sensor encoders, and both thin-film and thick-film chip resistors. Its product lines also encompass circuit protection solutions such as inrush current limiters and temperature sensors, along with reference designs and design tools to accelerate customer development.

These components serve the automotive, industrial, computing, consumer, telecommunications, military, aerospace, and medical markets, as well as alternative energy applications. Specific automotive-grade optocouplers and MOSFETs, medical-grade MOSFETs, and parts qualified for telecommunications infrastructure are among the documented applications.

Vishay emphasizes its extensive component selection and a focus on quality to support reliable data transmission that is resistant to electromagnetic and radio-frequency interference, as well as cyber-security threats. The company positions its portfolio as enabling space savings, improved thermal performance, and higher power density in customer designs.

name: Vision Autobody Parts
old_description: Durable, stylish, and road-safe tail lights for every vehicle.
about:
Vision Autobody Parts operates from Lawrence, Massachusetts, supplying aftermarket replacement components for passenger vehicles. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The product catalog focuses on exterior lighting and body panels, including tail lights, headlights, bumper covers, fenders, hoods, and mirrors. Each item is marketed as a factory-original-quality replacement, and the company offers free shipping on orders exceeding $80. Orders can be placed by phone Monday through Saturday, with support staff available during those hours.

Customers include vehicle owners and repair shops seeking cost-effective alternatives to OEM parts for collision repair and cosmetic upgrades. The business emphasizes competitive pricing across its entire product range and promotes durable, road-safe lighting solutions designed for all-weather performance. The company's online presence highlights a selection of premium tail lights and high-performance headlights as core offerings.

name: Vitrazza
old_description: Order online or call , Mon-Fri 7:00am-4:30pm MT.
about:
Vitrazza is based in Golden, Colorado. In late 2012, the business was acquired by George Pardo, who transformed Glass Solutions Inc. into Vitrazza. Founders Robert Livingston and Bill Fitzgerald had built a local dealer network before retiring.

Vitrazza designs and sells tempered glass chair mats for carpet, hardwood, tile, and other flooring. The product line includes the Prima Collection (8 stock sizes), Moda Collection (12 premium sizes), and the Sola Collection (hand-painted, one-of-a-kind art pieces certified via blockchain). Proprietary features include Invisible Shield® Pro 15 scratch-resistant coating, furniture-quality polished edges with a mini-bevel, Luminoso™ low-iron ultra-clear glass, and the Stabil-a-Dot™ bumper system for stability. The company operates a national distribution center in Golden, CO, and offers same-day shipping for orders placed before 2:30 PM MT. They also sell complementary accessories: hubless office chair wheels, leather footrests, DeskGuard™ glass desk mats, and wood monitor risers.

Vitrazza serves the office furniture and ergonomic accessories markets, targeting both home-office consumers and commercial workplaces. Customers include individual professionals, corporate office managers, and interior designers seeking a durable, stylish alternative to plastic mats. The company sells direct-to-consumer nationwide via eCommerce and also works with dealers.

The company was started to eliminate the irritation of rolling over dented plastic mats, add a designer look to workspaces, and supply the last chair mat a customer ever needs to buy. Vitrazza emphasizes a transferable lifetime warranty, free shipping and returns in the contiguous U.S., and in-house, concierge-style customer service based in Golden, Colorado.
